translation:
Nourishes and tonifies the kidney water, warms and nourishes the lesser fire, and is suitable for men and women alike in all deficiencies and the hundred kinds of damage; taken long-term it repels disease and prolongs life.

Huai Dihuang (4 liang; moisten with wine, steam and sun-dry nine times, slice with a bamboo knife, boil in wine, and pound into a paste). Gan Gouqi (4 liang; steam twice in human milk, and while hot together with). Chuan Xuduan (2 liang, stir-fried in wine). Chuan Niuxi (2 liang, stir-fried in wine). Chuan Duzhong (2 liang, stir-fried with ginger juice until the threads break). Shanzhuyu (core removed and cleaned, 2 liang, washed with wine, steamed, sun-dried, and stir-fried). Yuanzhi flesh (washed with water, bone removed, sun-dried, 2 liang, stir-fried). Shichangpu (use the small kind with dense nodes, fuzz removed, 2 liang, stir-fried). Chushizi (picked clean, 2 liang, stir-fried). Xiao Huixiang (2 liang, stir-fried). Bai Fuling (skin and wood bits removed, washed clean in water, steamed and sun-dried, 2 liang). Huai Shanyao (2 liang, steamed and stir-fried).

Process each and blend evenly. Take two hundred jujube-flesh pieces, pound and blend, add refined honey, and make into pills the size of wuzi. Each morning and evening, with boiling water or good wine, swallow freely fifty to seventy pills. Taken long-term, this pill strengthens the sinews and bones, opens the joints and orifices, fills the essence and blood, and beautifies the complexion; it has great nourishing benefit and is the greatest treasure of health preservation. In former times an immortal secretly transmitted it and had a woman take it; she indeed attained a great age and had a face like a child. Because her son did not take it, his beard and hair became white and his sinews and bones weak, and she would at times angrily scold him. An official, seeing from afar, seized and asked why the woman was beating her father. The woman said, "This is my son; because he does not take my medicine, I beat him." He took the formula, admired and praised it, and named it the Beating-the-Old-Son Pill. It was originally obtained by Master Sun from the Dragon Palace; all kidney-channel tonics may be gradually added to it.
translator_notes: 少火 (lesser fire) refers to the normal fire that sustains life.
人乳 (human milk) is used in processing medicines.
打老兒丸 (Beating-the-Old-Son Pill) is a name meaning the pill for beating one's aged son.
孫真人 (Master Sun) refers to Sun Simiao.
